subject: general
question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

A lover of oneself, of one’s advancement
solution:
The correct answer is: **Egoist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "egoist" is the correct option as it represents a person who is excessively self-centered or self-focused.
 
• An egoist is someone who loves and prioritizes oneself and is primarily concerned with personal advancement and well-being.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Egoist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The meanings of the rest of the options are given below:
 
 
• **Philistine: **Philistine refers to a person who is indifferent or hostile to artistic, intellectual, or cultural values and pursuits. In Hindi: संगीत और कला के प्रति असंवेदनशील व्यक्ति
 
• **Mercenary: **Mercenary describes a person who is motivated primarily by personal gain or profit, often willing to do anything for money or material rewards. In Hindi: प्रवासी सैनिक
 
• **Cynic: **Cynic refers to a person who distrusts or doubts the motives and sincerity of others, often having a pessimistic or negative outlook on life. In Hindi: नास्तिक
